scripts/build-smto-manual.py

Python · Tier B

Package the canonical product manual for the standalone website container.

Usage

python scripts/build-smto-manual.py --output artifacts/smto-site/wheels

Inputs

src/manual, shared branding/error assets, pyproject dependencies and maintained source.

Side effects

Generates references with the product generator and builds one temporary wheel.

Cleanup

Temporary staging is removed. Only the requested wheel output is retained.

@see src/manual/reference_builder.py

@see src/manual/assets.py

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
copy_file 38 Copy canonical bytes, rejecting links rather than following external build inputs.
copy_tree 46 Include nested historical content and future assets without a second content list.
stage_manual 58 Project one checkout into package files and the product's generated resource format.
build 77 Build from shared sources; only rendering/server dependencies enter the final wheel.
